source.novel_day_definition: first exact 96-value profile in original source dates; retrospective audit only

design.target: maximum of 4 interval values strictly after origin through origin+60min >= training raw-quarter power95
design.target_is_not: endpoint-only exceedance, instantaneous electrical peak, contract violation, or independent physical event count
design.features: same fixed endpoint-indexed features as previous 60-minute task; all lags >=4 quarters
design.training_label_end: no later than first calibration forecast origin
design.calibration_label_end: no later than first test forecast origin
design.threshold: raw per-quarter training power95, not rolling-max95; monthly fixed
design.alert_policy: strict score > calibration-normal order statistic at 1/3/5% budgets, ties conservative
design.models: same fixed balanced logistic/HGB as classifier_experiment; no hyperparameter search
design.overlap: one forecast window every15min; adjacent windows share3 future quarters
design.novel_profile_audit: retrospective daily-hash masks only; all_target_quarters_new_profile requires all4 source-day masks true
design.known_test_exposure: exploratory follow-up; these dates informed topic selection and endpoint experiments
